title: human milk donation in the context of culture and religion – sub-study 1
summary: The doctoral project investigates human milk donation in the context of culture and religion. The project consists of a qualitative systematic review, qualitative  interviews with Muslim (expectant) mothers (sub-study 1) and focus group interviews with experts (sub-study 2). Interview data will be used to determine the acceptance of donor breast milk by Muslim (expectant) mothers. This research contributes to the establishment of diversity justice and equal opportunities in the care of heterogeneous patients.
conditions: Muslim mothers with proof of pregnancy, Muslim mothers during the postpartum period

interventions.name: Qualitative interviews with Muslim mothers with confirmed pregnancies and with Muslim mothers during the postpartum period

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Mothers with proof of pregnancy
- Mothers during the postpartum period
- Age: 18-35 years
- Religion: Islam
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of capacity to give consent
- Mothers during a high-risk pregnancy
